**Review: clean (read, not built).** Head 799770ff5. Label: merge-ready. P3 set from #3004.

What the change does:
- The tilted (3+2) verify branch starts its local stock cap at negative infinity and takes the maximum of the projected corners of the stock box and the model box, in the plane's own frame. The world top `stock_top_z - oz` is no longer a floor: it is a world-Z height, and on a side plane (A +90 / A -90) it held the cap at the blank's 70 mm where the true local cap is 30 mm. That made the shank law and the first-traverse law name clear air as a hit.

Checks I made:
- The direction of the change is fail-safe. `f.z_local` is affine, so its maximum over each box equals its maximum over the box corners; the box contains the facets, so the new cap is at least the true material maximum along the local axis. It can never sit lower than the material and hide a collision; it only stops sitting too high.
- `st_local` is always set: every operation reaches this branch through validated, finite facets, so the model-box loop contributes finite corners. I checked the empty-lo/hi worry: it cannot reach `verify_bodies` here.
- The rest of the generate.rs change is the two comments; the code path is 12 lines.
- Pins: `tilt_stock_cap.rs` - a side pocket (no `ShankHit`; red before with the exact warning list in the body), a side slot (no warnings; red before), and the unchanged top-plane case. Mutation record present (upstream generate.rs: two pins red). Decision file `docs/decisions/3004-local-stock-cap.md`.
- Author's quick gate green (117 steps); clippy clean; heavy lanes did not run per the body.

Not built here: runner m3 is busy with run 44851610265 (#3053).

Note: this changes a collision check (safety floor), so the merge batch gives it a read-only second review at the safety tier before the merge.
